newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Woodside to abandon Lynx-1A well.
newsitem.headline: Woodside to abandon Lynx-1A well.

text.p: Woodside Petroleum Ltd said on Tuesday it would plug and abandon the Lynx-1A exploration well in the Dampier sub-basin Of Western Australia's North West Shelf after reaching a depth of 5,190 metres.
A preliminary log interpretation indicated the presence of hydrocarbons in a tight, non-productive reservoir, it said.
After completing the current logging programme, it was planned to plug and abandon the well, the deepest yet to be drilled in the North West Shelf, a Woodside spokesman said.
Woodside shares closed 32 cents lower at A$8.06 in a weaker overall market.
Woodside holds a one-sixth stake in WA-28-P.
The other equal partners are BHP Petroleum (North West Shelf) Pty Ltd BP Developments Australia Ltd Shell Development Australia Pty Ltd, Chevron Asiatic Ltd and Japan Australia LNG (MIMI) Pty Ltd.
